title: Cinema Platform / Business
description: Revenue, tickets, refunds and what users do: browsing, checkouts, logins, notifications

options.content:
**Sales** comes straight from the bookings and payments databases (read-only user). Amounts are in hryvnias, days and hours are Kyiv time. Tickets and paid orders are counted by the moment they were paid; payments by when the checkout was created; refunds by when they happened. A refund deletes the tickets, so ticket counts are already net of refunds.

**Activity** below is counted from successful gateway responses: actions, not money.

panels.title: Revenue
panels.description: Successful payments that were not refunded

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS revenue FROM payments WHERE status = 'SUCCESS' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS tickets FROM tickets WHERE status = 'PAID' AND $__timeFilter(paid_at)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders FROM tickets WHERE status = 'PAID' AND $__timeFilter(paid_at)
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(total), 0) AS avg FROM (SELECT SUM(price) AS total FROM tickets WHERE status = 'PAID' AND $__timeFilter(paid_at) GROUP BY order_id) o
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(n), 0) AS avg FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM tickets WHERE status = 'PAID' AND $__timeFilter(paid_at) GROUP BY order_id) o

panels.title: Buyers
panels.description: Different users who paid for at least one order

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) AS buyers FROM tickets t JOIN orders o ON o.id = t.order_id WHERE t.status = 'PAID' AND $__timeFilter(t.paid_at)

panels.title: Refunded
panels.description: Money returned in the selected range (by refund time)

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS refunded FROM payments WHERE status = 'REFUNDED' AND $__timeFilter(updated_at)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS refunds FROM payments WHERE status = 'REFUNDED' AND $__timeFilter(updated_at)

panels.title: Refund rate
panels.description: Of the payments created in the range that went through, how many were refunded later

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'REFUNDED')::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('SUCCESS', 'REFUNDED')), 0) AS rate FROM payments WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Checkout → paid
panels.description: Checkouts created in the range that were paid. The rest were abandoned (PENDING) or declined (FAILED).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('SUCCESS', 'REFUNDED'))::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS rate FROM payments WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Declined payments
panels.description: LiqPay reported failure (card declined, insufficient funds, ...)

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS failed FROM payments WHERE status = 'FAILED' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Seats held by unpaid orders
panels.description: Right now, not filtered by time. Unpaid reservations never expire, so these seats can't be sold until the order is canceled.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS held FROM tickets WHERE status = 'RESERVED'

panels.title: Revenue and refunds
panels.description: Bucket size: the `Group by` variable at the top

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('$bucket', created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Kyiv') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Kyiv' AS time, 'revenue' AS metric, SUM(amount) AS value FROM payments WHERE status = 'SUCCESS' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('$bucket', updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Kyiv') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Kyiv' AS time, 'refunds' AS metric, SUM(amount) AS value FROM payments WHERE status = 'REFUNDED' AND $__timeFilter(updated_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('$bucket', paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Kyiv') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Kyiv' AS time, 'tickets' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM tickets WHERE status = 'PAID' AND $__timeFilter(paid_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('$bucket', paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Kyiv') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Kyiv' AS time, 'orders' AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS value FROM tickets WHERE status = 'PAID' AND $__timeFilter(paid_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Payments by status
panels.description: By checkout creation time. PENDING = the user never finished paying.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('$bucket', created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Kyiv') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Kyiv' AS time, status::text AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM payments WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Orders by status
panels.description: By order creation time. CANCELED = refunded after payment.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('$bucket', created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Kyiv') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Kyiv' AS time, status::text AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM orders WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Tickets by hour of day (Kyiv)
panels.description: When people buy

targets.rawSql: SELECT h.hour::text AS hour, COUNT(t.id) AS tickets FROM generate_series(0, 23) AS h(hour) LEFT JOIN tickets t ON t.status = 'PAID' AND $__timeFilter(t.paid_at) AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (t.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Kyiv')) = h.hour GROUP BY h.hour ORDER BY h.hour

SELECT d.name AS day, COUNT(t.id) AS tickets FROM (VALUES (1, 'Mon'), (2, 'Tue'), (3, 'Wed'), (4, 'Thu'), (5, 'Fri'), (6, 'Sat'), (7, 'Sun')) AS d(n, name) LEFT JOIN tickets t ON t.status = 'PAID' AND $__timeFilter(t.paid_at) AND EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM (t.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Kyiv')) = d.n GROUP BY d.n, d.name ORDER BY d.n

panels.title: Top screenings
panels.description: Ids only: movie and hall names live in other services' databases. Open GET /screenings/{id} to see which one it is.

targets.rawSql: SELECT screening_id, hall_id, COUNT(*) AS tickets, SUM(price) AS revenue, MAX(paid_at) AS last_sale FROM tickets WHERE status = 'PAID' AND $__timeFilter(paid_at) GROUP BY screening_id, hall_id ORDER BY tickets DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Unpaid orders older than 30 minutes
panels.description: Not filtered by time. These hold seats: the checkout was abandoned, or the LiqPay callback never arrived.

targets.rawSql: SELECT o.id, o.user_id, o.amount, COUNT(t.id) AS seats, o.created_at, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' - o.created_at)) AS age FROM orders o JOIN tickets t ON t.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'PENDING' AND o.created_at < NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' - INTERVAL '30 minutes' GROUP BY o.id ORDER BY o.created_at LIMIT 50

panels.title: Latest payments
panels.description: For support: find a payment by booking or LiqPay id

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at, updated_at, status::text AS status, amount, booking_id, user_id, provider_id FROM payments WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Funnel
panels.description: Checkout started = seats reserved and a LiqPay checkout created. LiqPay sends a callback on every status change, so (4) is callbacks, not paid orders.

panels.title: Seat already taken
panels.description: Checkout attempts rejected because someone else got the seat first

panels.title: Refunds failed
panels.description: Booking canceled but LiqPay refund failed; check the payment-service logs

targets.expr: (sum(increase(http_requests_total{route="/payment/init", method="POST", status=~"2.."}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / ((sum(increase(http_requests_total{route="/seats/hall/:hallId", method="GET", status=~"2.."}[$__range])) or vector(0)) > 0)

panels.title: Payment callback failures
panels.description: Confirming the booking failed and auto-refund failed too; needs manual handling

panels.title: Logins (Telegram)
panels.description: verify + finalize (finalize = first Telegram login, phone linked)

targets.expr: (sum(increase(http_requests_total{route="/auth/telegram/verify", method="POST", status=~"2.."}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(http_requests_total{route="/auth/telegram/finalize", method="POST", status=~"2.."}[$__range])) or vector(0))

(sum(increase(http_requests_total{route="/account/email/confirm", method="POST", status=~"2.."}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(http_requests_total{route="/account/phone/confirm", method="POST", status=~"2.."}[$__range])) or vector(0))

(sum(increase(http_requests_total{route="/users/@me", method="PATCH", status=~"2.."}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(http_requests_total{route="/users/@me/avatar", method="PATCH", status=~"2.."}[$__range])) or vector(0))

panels.title: Notifications sent by type
panels.description: Emails/SMS actually sent in the selected range

panels.title: Catalog changes (selected range)
panels.description: Successful admin create/update/delete calls
